card.name: Liquids about to boil, evaporate or dispense
card.fires_on: The word "to" (or a word start like "ev" or "disp") right after a liquid such as wine, water or solvent, where a verb like simmer, boil, evaporate or dispense comes next. It also fires on "Disp" in syringe contents instructions.

modes.description: The word "to" after wine, water or solvents, just before simmer, boil or evaporate.

modes.description: The start of "dispense" when a dose or syringe contents are delivered.

modes.label: Start of evaporation
modes.description: The start of "evaporation" in watering advice.

card.writes: It promotes word beginnings like "enti" and "enco" and suppresses liquid words, so it seems to steer away from repeating "liquid".
card.plain: It fires when a liquid is about to boil, evaporate or be dispensed, at the word just before that action.
